title: Least Privilege
objective: Detect excessive, ungoverned, or role-inappropriate access.

automated_checks.evidence: Privileged grants missing required lineage are denied.
Developer access to Payroll is denied.
Alice's ungoverned production access is a required denial fixture.
Explainable access risk can open a human-owned review with immutable decisions and no implicit privilege changes.
A reproducible advisory peer model detects unusual entitlement profiles without protected characteristics.

limitations: The synthetic peer cohort must be replaced or calibrated with governed production telemetry before operational use.
Anomaly classification is advisory and cannot authorize, deny, or revoke access.
